blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Sibol settled for bronze in the Pokémon Unite event of the Asian Games 2026 esports competition after a 2-0 semifinal loss to Indonesia on Sunday at Aichi Sky Expo. The Philippines let a big lead slip away in the opening game before Indonesia pulled away early in the second to end Sibol’s run at the gold medal. The bronze, however, gave the Philippines its first esports medal in the Asian Games.
